title: The Juice Merchant | Narberth's Cold-Pressed Juice & Smoothie Bar
name: The Juice Merchant
description: Fresh juice, smoothies, and bowls made to order in Narberth, PA.
h3: It's Made When You Order It
paras: Fresh juice, smoothies, and bowls made to order in Narberth, PA.

The Juice Merchant is a juice bar in Narberth built around fresh, simple food: cold-pressed juices, smoothies, and bowls made to order for anyone looking for something clean on the way to work or after a workout. The menu suits regulars who want the same reliable order every time, and first-timers trying a cleanse or reset. Everything is made fresh rather than sitting bottled on a shelf, from a single juice to a full catering tray for a local event.
Fresh cold-pressed juice blends made from fruits and vegetables, pressed to order rather than sitting on a shelf.
Fruit and vegetable smoothies blended to order, built for a quick breakfast, a post-workout refuel, or an afternoon pick-me-up.
Thick smoothie bases topped with fruit, granola, and other toppings for a sit-down or grab-and-go bowl.
Multi-day juice cleanse packages for anyone looking to reset with fresh-pressed juice instead of solid food for a stretch.
Juice, smoothie, and bowl trays available for local events, meetings, and gatherings around Narberth.
Choose a cold-pressed juice, a smoothie, or a bowl, or ask about a multi-day cleanse package.
